description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small team building AI agents for marketing across content, social, and search. As the first senior AI hire, you will own agent quality and intelligence, shape the AI architecture and evaluation approach, and help grow the AI team.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Improve the quality of agent-generated content for social platforms and articles, using evaluation systems to make quality measurable.

 - Improve performance in search engine optimization and generative engine optimization.

 - Build feedback loops that help agents learn from real-world outcomes and performance signals at scale.

 - Improve AI infrastructure, agent architecture, model strategy, and supporting data pipelines.

 - Help hire and lead the AI team as it grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years building production machine learning or AI systems, including recent hands-on experience shipping LLM products or agents.

 - Experience designing evaluations and learning from outcome signals at scale in search, ranking, recommendations, or related areas.

 - Strong TypeScript, including Next.js, and Python skills for data analysis, evaluations, and model work, with the ability to ship end to end.

 - Experience building feedback loops and improving AI infrastructure, agent architecture, or model strategy in production.

 - Ownership experience in a startup or small-team environment, plus familiarity with search, ranking, or AI answer engines.

 - Marketing or go-to-market experience is helpful; recommendation systems, algorithms, and reinforcement learning experience are also relevant.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Target annual compensation is $180,000 to $230,000 USD. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in the United States.
